## About

Studdy Buddy is an EdTech platform by A5X Industries, built for school students in India to learn Robotics, IoT, AI/ML, and Embedded Systems.

The platform is accessed through a school-partnership model with A5X Industries. Students get structured courses, expert mentorship, doubt resolution, a peer community, and XP-based gamified learning.

## Platform URL

https://studdybuddy.a5x.in

## Company

A5X Industries — https://a5x.in

## Courses Offered

- Introduction to Robotics: Servo motors, sensors, Arduino programming, robot building
- IoT with ESP32: Cloud-connected smart devices, sensor integration
- AI/ML on Edge: TensorFlow Lite on microcontrollers
- RTOS Fundamentals: FreeRTOS, task scheduling, embedded software
- Embedded C Programming: Memory-efficient code for microcontrollers

## Key Features

- Structured video courses with quizzes
- Expert mentors in Robotics, IoT, AI/ML
- Doubt resolution system
- Student peer community
- XP points and gamified rewards
- School-partnership enrollment model

## Target Audience

School students aged 12–18 in India interested in Robotics, IoT, AI, and Electronics.
